# Agent Resources

> Public operations hub and CLI for reusable Agent Skills.

## Canonical public surfaces

- Dashboard: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/
- CLI / Skills docs: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/
- Source: https://github.com/KAFKA2306/agent-resources

## Install

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/KAFKA2306/agent-resources.git
```

## Common commands

```bash
agr add anthropics/skills/frontend-design
agrx anthropics/skills/pdf
agr sync
agr list
```

## Documentation

- Creating skills: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/creating/
- CLI reference: https://agent-resources-one.vercel.app/site/reference/
- Agent Skills specification: https://agentskills.io/

## Scope

The repository provides `agr` / `agrx`, reusable skills and plugins, public CLI documentation, and a public Dashboard for KAFKA2306 GitHub operations. Repository, GitHub, deployment, production, and primary sources remain the canonical evidence for underlying state.
